summary: Write and, on approval, run one qpu:ascella job that repeats job-02's 56 nonzero compilation seeds and 8 seed-0 anchors in a QRNG-permuted order, testing whether each served mesh carries a reproducible analyzer error.

reconciliation.note: The readings below are fixed in this record before acquisition. Every error family fitted on job-00 assumes the per-mesh deviation of job-02 is a deterministic function of the returned mesh, and reproducibility is shown only at seed 0 (job-00 read 0.881 and job-02's anchors 0.883 on the same mesh). Maring et al. (arXiv:2306.00874, Fig. 1 caption) describe hourly recalibration of phi = A V^2 + b, so job-03 runs under another calibration than job-02; the seed-0 anchors are the control for that change.

scope: Job-03 submits job-02's 64 settings (theta2-x-arm0, 16,384 samples per iteration) with job-02's seeds, imported from SEED_DRAW by name. The 8 anchors keep every eighth position; the 56 perturbed meshes take the off-stride positions in the order of values 0..55 of the ANU QRNG draw docs/evidence/anu_qrng/draw-2026-10-26T033936Z.json, so each mesh's predecessor changes. Value 56 of that draw seeds the permutation nulls. Readings at alpha 0.01, on the block-conditioned X statistic of scripts/ascella_compilation_reading.py: M, mesh identity: the count of settings whose computed_circuit equals job-02's for the same name; A, P1 and P2 read the identical subset, and if no perturbed mesh repeats, job-03's meshes join the held-out set of ascella-mesh-response-decomposition and P1 is not read. A, anchor control: the difference of job-03's and job-02's anchor mean X in counting standard errors. P1, per-mesh reproduction: Pearson r of the 56 perturbed X statistics between job-02 and job-03 against 20,000 label permutations. A fully fixed per-mesh error predicts r at the attenuation ceiling 0.880 = s_c^2 / sqrt((s_c^2 + s_n^2)(s_c^2 + s_n^2 / 2)), with job-02's compilation-induced SD s_c 0.01037 and counting variance s_n^2 1.965e-5 at 8,192 samples, halved at job-03's 16,384; the Fisher-z 0.01 lower bound of that ceiling on 56 meshes is 0.784. P1 reads fixed per mesh at p < 0.01 and r >= 0.784, partly fixed at p < 0.01 and r < 0.784, and not reproduced at p >= 0.01. The test detects at power 0.9 a correlation of 0.459, a fixed share of 52 % of the compilation variance. P2, replicated compilation dependence: job-02's R1 anchor-ratio test applied to job-03 alone. Exploratory, outside the decision: the Spearman correlation of per-mesh dark-output (mode 2) counts between the jobs, and the Spearman correlation of each mesh's X change between the jobs with the change of its predecessor's L1 compiled-phase distance. Reading P1 with A: reproduction with steady anchors places the error in a fixed per-mesh property; no reproduction with steady anchors places it in the compilation or calibration in force at each job; a moved anchor mean places a calibration change between the jobs, and P1 then reads a lower bound on the fixed share.
next_action: None; a model of the map from a served mesh to its fixed error, scored on the per-mesh statistics of job-02 and job-03, is a new plan.

steps.action: Register job-03 in ascella_coherence_request.py: job-02's seeds by name, anchors at stride 8, the perturbed meshes in the draw's order, the frozen body and a preflight that sends nothing.
steps.acceptance: --check reproduces the frozen bytes of jobs 00 to 03 and validates job-03's body; every job-03 setting carries job-02's seed and circuit_params under the same name.

receipts.result: ascella_coherence_request.py registers job-03 at the approved 16,384 samples; --check rebuilds jobs 00 to 03 to their retained digests and validates job-03's frozen body.

steps.action: Write the case in the design document: what it measures, why simulation cannot answer it, backend, samples, seconds and credits.
steps.acceptance: The owner approves the written case, or declines it.

receipts.result: The owner approved the written case on 2026-10-26 at 16,384 samples per iteration, ceiling 1.032768 credits, expected 186 s; the run's submission record carries the approval text the submission consumed.

steps.action: Submit on approval, collect, retain and apply M, A, P1 and P2 as fixed in this record, with the exploratory readings labeled.
steps.acceptance: A retained run and a reading record with every fixed reading and its gate.

receipts.result: Job e2f30d83 completed and is retained; seed-repeat-reading.json applies M, A, P1 and P2: every served mesh repeats, the anchors stay steady, P1 reads fixed per mesh (r 0.885, p 5e-5) and P2 compilation dependent; core-ascella-signed-coherence-seed-repeat-reading-replay replays it.

resolution: Every served mesh of job-02 repeats in job-03, nine hours and a platform calibration later, and so does its analyzer error: the 56 per-mesh X statistics correlate at r 0.885 (p 5e-5) against the 0.880 ceiling of a fully fixed error, with steady anchors; the per-mesh deviation is a deterministic function of the served mesh.

receipts.result: All three steps are done; the run, the reading record and its replay gate are retained, and claim ascella-signed-coherence-seed-repeat registers the result.
